description: Retrieve a complete published Spot or The General Average research page by canonical path or URL, including /industries, industry pillars and vertical guides at /industries/{slug}, their FAQs at /industries/{slug}/{question}, provider profiles, comparisons, best-of rankings at /best, /best/{line} and /best/{line}/{segment}, reviews, scores, rankings, and methodology. Industry pages include parent and vertical links; lists are complete even when the website collapses them. Drafts, customer-specific guides, submissions, and unknown paths are unavailable.
name: get_page
title: Get a published Spot page
